purpose: Explain hierarchical and temporal design for assistant memory

required_facts.fact: Flat RAG does not express importance or temporal validity well.
MemPalace uses wings, rooms, halls, drawers, tunnels and closets.
Room detection uses paths, filenames and keyword scores.
L0 through L3 load progressively more memory.
The wake-up cost is about 600–900 tokens.
Temporal triples have valid_from and valid_to.
AAAK removes stop words and encodes entities and flags.
The reported hierarchy result is 94.8% versus 60.9% flat search.

author_attribution: Explain the open-source MemPalace design by Milla Jovovich and Ben Sigman without presenting benchmark claims as universal.
